articles.title: Buttigieg allies launch effort to back another presidential run
articles.author: Adam Wren
articles.summary: Allies launch the independent Team Pete PAC to urge a second Buttigieg presidential run, organizing 2020 volunteers and grassroots donors. Led by Jennifer Holdsworth and Mohsin Syed. Says it has no ties to Win the Era PAC and is not a presidential committee. Through Win the Era, Buttigieg campaigned with 102 midterm candidates in 38 states.

articles.title: Jennifer Holdsworth - Senior Vice President of Issues Management of MWWPR
articles.summary: Bio of Team Pete PAC co-lead Jennifer Holdsworth: attorney and Democratic strategist in Washington, DC; SVP of Issues Management and senior political strategist at MWWPR; managed Buttigieg's 2017 DNC chair run; national finance director and senior political adviser to Rep. Seth Moulton and Serve America PAC; NJ state director, Hillary for America 2016; Booker 2014 coordinated campaign director. Exact page URL wasn't saved (site: worldwithoutexploitation.org).

gaps: Team Pete PAC registered on 19 Nov 2026 and has no reported activity yet.

articles.title: Latest Beshear PAC report shows continuing signs of a presidential run
articles.author: Tom Loftus
articles.summary: In This Together's May 2026 report looks like a presidential committee: more donors from Iowa than any state but Kentucky, 7 from South Carolina, and its largest gift was $25,000 to the New Hampshire Democratic Party. Pays Beshear's travel and the salaries of Eric Hyers and other consultants. $1.81M cash at start of June. Files partly with the FEC and partly with the IRS. Top May donors: Lucy Phillips $50,000 (first-time Beshear donor), William T. Young $20,000, Britt Brockman $15,000.

gaps: In This Together reports some activity to the IRS rather than the FEC (Kentucky Lantern), so FEC data is partial. About $500K in independent expenditures isn't included.

articles.title: Gallego tapped campaign cash for family travel, Super Bowl tickets, records show
articles.author: Irie Sentner
articles.summary: POLITICO review: Gallego used Juntos PAC and his campaign for family trips (Miami, Chicago, Disneyland, Disney World, St. Barts), >$18,000 in child care incl. au pair company payments, and a 2023 Super Bowl via the Swallego Victory Fund with Eric Swalwell. Juntos PAC (est. Feb 2024 per article) raised ~$1.5M, over half from corporate PACs. Andrew Bates hired for political communications; Jacques Petit is communications director.
